title: My new job
instructions: Laura yeni işini anlatıyor. Uzun bir metin; eskiyle yeniyi ve "but" ile gelen bilgileri ayırt et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: laura
script.text: Hi, I'm Laura. Last month I started a new job.

script.speaker: laura
script.text: Before, I was a teacher in a primary school. Now I work in a bookshop in the city centre.

script.speaker: laura
script.text: I love books, so it's a great job for me.

script.speaker: laura
script.text: I start work at nine thirty, but I get up early, at seven, because I go to work by train.

script.speaker: laura
script.text: I work from Tuesday to Saturday. My free days are Sunday and Monday.

script.speaker: laura
script.text: In the morning, I put new books on the shelves and answer the phone.

script.speaker: laura
script.text: In the afternoon, I help customers. Many children come with their parents.

script.speaker: laura
script.text: My manager, Sam, is very kind. He is younger than me, but he knows a lot about books.

script.speaker: laura
script.text: The money isn't very good, but I'm happy.

script.speaker: laura
script.text: On Saturdays, there's a story hour for children, and I read to them. It's my favourite part of the week.

questions.feedback: Laura önceden ilkokulda öğretmendi (I was a teacher).
questions.evidence: Before, I was a teacher in a primary school.

questions.prompt: What time does Laura get up?
questions.feedback: Yedide (at seven) kalkıyor. Dokuz buçuk işe başlama saati.
questions.evidence: I get up early, at seven

questions.prompt: Which day does Laura NOT work?
questions.feedback: Salıdan cumartesiye çalışıyor; boş günleri pazar ve pazartesi (Monday).
questions.evidence: My free days are Sunday and Monday.

questions.prompt: What does Laura say about Sam?
questions.feedback: Sam ondan genç (younger than me) ama kitaplar hakkında çok şey biliyor.
questions.evidence: He is younger than me, but he knows a lot about books.

questions.prompt: What is Laura's favourite part of the week?
questions.feedback: En sevdiği kısım cumartesi çocuklara kitap okuduğu hikâye saati (story hour).
questions.evidence: It's my favourite part of the week.
